_header.description: axe violation-count ratchet over the plan 781 scanned route set (WCAG 2.1 A/AA tags). Any (route x rule) count above baseline fails tests/e2e/a11y-axe-baseline.spec.ts; lower numbers are a tightening hint. Fix violations (component owner) or consciously re-register with a note.

excludedRoutes.map-demo: axe analysis exceeds a practical timeout (heavy SVG DOM, >120 s single-worker)

_header._notes: plan 798 Phase 1: stale ids gantt-demo / crud-demo scanned the home page (routes no longer exist). Keys migrated to the real hash segments (gantt, complex-pages/standard-crud); counts re-measured on the target pages on first run 2026-10-30 — the old home-page counts were empty {} and are not transferable (D1 §4 纪律). wms-pda-receiving registered per the D6 unified A+B single-key: the mobile-canvas branch B scan is the registered scan (D6 MAJ-C: the canvas DOM does not vary with viewport, one scan suffices).
